package.description: a package, read from its manifest; its entity id is derived from its name, so every checkout of it is one entity

name.description: the name its manifest publishes it under

manifest.description: the module the package was read from: its deno.json

module.description: one file of a codebase, read from the file itself; it wears the `file` it was read from, which identifies it, and its `doc` is its opening paragraph

blob.description: the Git blob id of the text it was read from; a sync reads the file again only when this moved

package.description: the package the file belongs to: the nearest manifest above it

symbol.description: a definition a module exports; identified by the module and its name, so a citation of it survives the file moving around it. Its `doc` is its doc comment

name.description: the name it is exported under

kind.description: what it is, as `deno doc` says: function, variable, class, interface, typeAlias, enum or namespace

line.description: the line it is declared on, counting from 1

imports.description: edge tag: this module imports or re-exports that one

code_sync.title: Sync the codebase
code_sync.description: Read the codebase of the checkout this call runs in into the graph: a package per manifest, a module per TypeScript, JavaScript or Markdown file Git tracks, a symbol per export, and an `imports` link per import. Only files whose Git blob moved since the last sync are read again; a file that is gone has its module and symbols cleared, never deleted, so a path or name that comes back is the same entity. Returns a one-paragraph report of what it read, cleared and how long it took.

full.description: read every file, not only the ones that moved
